examples.text: One-by-one the warning fliers turned up in mailboxes around Wylie Heights in North Sewickley, Beaver County: It advised, there is a chemical in your water supply called dihydrogen monoxide. In fact, the flier said, dihydrogen monoxide kills thousands every year.
